mapper.sql: rule_id, name, pattern, flags, capture_kind, description, enabled, sort_order, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms
mapper.select: SELECT FROM smart_sort_rule ORDER BY sort_order ASC, rule_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO smart_sort_rule (rule_id, name, pattern, flags, capture_kind, description, enabled, sort_order, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{name}, #{pattern}, #{flags}, #{captureKind}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAtMs}, #{updatedAtMs})

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO smart_sort_rule (rule_id, name, pattern, flags, capture_kind, description, enabled, sort_order, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{name}, #{pattern}, #{flags}, #{captureKind}, #{description}, 1, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAtMs}, #{updatedAtMs})
mapper.update: UPDATE smart_sort_rule SET sort_order = CASE rule_id WHEN #{pair.ruleId} THEN #{pair.sortOrder} ELSE sort_order END WHERE rule_id IN (#{pair.ruleId})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) AS max_sort FROM smart_sort_rule
